RV-007.reason: Every realtime event name pycore handles comes from QUEUE_CENTER_REALTIME_EVENTS. A grep of pycore/ and pyapps/ for the 8 contract event names finds no literal. snapshot_service._head_entries reads the keys of each priority event at its contract realtime.head_keys path (task_id; items[].resource_key). Since D10 it keeps only keys that realtime_head_key_valid accepts. That function's patterns are compiled from realtime.resource_key_formats; the probe confirms library:[^:]+ and [^:]+:[^:]+, and 12 cases, including library:1:2, book:3 as a cover key and an empty key, behave as expected. The synthetic event-<cursor> head is gone, and cover all=true (empty items) adds no head. The shapes match the Laravel producers: AssistController emits cover.priority with items[].resource_key=library:<id> and poster.priority with <media_type>:<id> (book|subtitle). AppQyV1TranslationRealtimeService::priority is the only task.priority producer, and it sends one top-level task_id. So gating translation-worker priority on QUEUE_CENTER_TASK_PRIORITY_QUEUE and removing the items[].task_id loop loses no producer.

The article md5 is not a word_identity field.
